description: This file defines an Android activity 'FragmentReceiveResult' that manages a fragment to receive results from another activity. It includes a nested fragment class 'ReceiveResultFragment' which handles launching an activity for a result and processing that result in 'onActivityResult'.

classes.name: FragmentReceiveResult
classes.description: An Android activity that hosts a fragment used to start another activity for a result and handle the returned result.

classes.name: FragmentReceiveResult.ReceiveResultFragment
classes.description: A fragment that initiates an activity for a result and processes that result in 'onActivityResult'.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the FrameLayout, and adds the 'ReceiveResultFragment' if it's the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment, initializes the TextView and Button, and sets up the button click listener to start activity for result.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result returned from the started activity, updates the TextView with the result details.
